evidence.text: Haulsense Telematics provides fleet tracking and driver-safety analytics for regional trucking companies. Our in-cab gateway records driving events and uploads them to the Haulsense cloud dashboard over cellular networks.

The Haulsense Gateway is a compact in-cab device sold with a monthly per-vehicle subscription to the Haulsense dashboard. A dashcam add-on is available. Video analysis currently runs in our cloud after upload.
We are hiring an embedded engineer to explore running driver-distraction detection directly on the gateway to reduce cellular data costs.

opportunity.thesis: Share Northwind's edge-inference expertise and fleet management software to help Haulsense move driver-distraction detection onto edge hardware, potentially at depots where vehicles offload video.
opportunity.ownBrings: Edge AI inference know-how and fleet management software for edge devices.
opportunity.targetBrings: An installed base of in-cab gateways and a concrete need for on-device inference.

evidence.text: Vantor Secure Analytics delivers video analytics for critical infrastructure sites. Deploy 100% on-premise: your footage never leaves your site.
All Vantor plans are hosted in the Vantor cloud. On-premise installation is not available at this time.
Vantor Secure Analytics is headquartered in Lyon, France.
Vantor Secure Analytics told us it is preparing an on-premises edition for 2027, aimed at customers in the energy sector.
